purpose: Revision 7: long Korean error-page headings get a line break at a word boundary (english.lng \n escape) and the error page h1 gets white-space: pre-line, so Opera no longer ends a line inside a word.
error_heading_css_reason: Opera 9.30 for Wii has no word-break/word-wrap property; pre-line honours the line feed and still wraps a line that is too long, so a narrower layout behaves like v6.

model.observation: lead Dolphin review of build-v5 (h1 130%, 16:9 profile): first line ended at 없습니, second line 다.
